reviews.rationale: Sequential comparison of selected SEC rows shows GAAP net interest income up while the GAAP credit loss provision rose by a similar magnitude, so GAAP net interest income after provision was essentially unchanged; the sequential increase in GAAP pretax income, net income, net income to common and diluted EPS therefore traces to higher GAAP noninterest income against nearly flat GAAP noninterest expense. FTE net interest income and FTE net interest margin also rose slightly on a non-GAAP basis. The selected rows do not identify the drivers of the higher noninterest income, the higher provision, or the interest income and expense movements, and they contain no guidance, no year-over-year comparison, no balance-sheet or capital detail, and no reconciliation between the GAAP and non-GAAP net interest measures. Because the earnings-quality mix shifted toward noninterest income while credit provisioning rose, and because the causal drivers are unresolved in this extract, the research state is held for review rather than upgraded.

Output contract for this development workflow: after the finance-tool review and alert update, return exactly one JSON object and no Markdown. Do not let the output contract choose your financial implication or research-state decision. The JSON must have exactly three top-level keys: claims, interpretation, asserted_state.
claims is a nonempty array of typed material quantitative assertions. Each assertion must use selected-source metric names and one supported op: delta(metric,value,unit,basis); compare_delta(left_metric,right_metric,relation gt|lt|eq,magnitudes optional,cross_basis_explicit optional); ratio_direction(numerator_metric,denominator_metric,relation); delta_share_percent(numerator_metric,denominator_metric,value); gap_direction(left_metric,right_metric,relation,cross_basis_explicit optional); or signed_delta_identity(total_metric,terms with metric and sign +1/-1,value). Include every material numerical, direction, rank, gap or proportional comparison you rely on. Omit unsupported assertions; a missing fact is a research limit, not a zero. Never infer economic causation from an accounting identity alone.
interpretation has exactly implication, counterevidence and uncertainty, each a nonempty qualitative string. Do not put numbers, currency or percentages in these strings or the saved review rationale; quantitative claims belong in claims and the stored event facts. Explain your supported implication, the most material opposing evidence and what would be needed to resolve uncertainty.
asserted_state has exactly review_id, evidence_ids, next_review_at, decision_hold, actionability and alert_status. Populate them from actual tool results and saved ledger state, not from intended tool arguments. If a review write fails, do not invent a review ID or claim the thesis is blocked; report the tool error instead of a completed candidate. Never trade or recommend a trade.
